function: Cascaded BS-IRS-user channel estimation with fewer pilots: IRS elements are deactivated, then the missing channel is recovered and denoised by a learned attention and CNN network (pp. 1, 5).
system: BS ULA with Nt=16, single-antenna user, passive reflecting IRS 12x12 UPA (M=144), mmWave 28 GHz, OFDM, TDD, direct link blocked (pp. 3, 9).
method: Two-stage network: CAN (axial self-attention with convolutions) then CMN (residual CNN denoiser); supervised, MSE loss; CAN trained first, then frozen while CMN trains (pp. 6-7).
data_channel: Synthetic 3GPP TR 38.901 Rel-17 CDL, UMi, 28 GHz; 80,000 samples: 50,000 train, 20,000 validation, 10,000 test; no measured data (p. 9).
test_conditions: Trained on UMi at several SNRs; tested on held-out UMi and on UMa without adaptation (p. 11); also varied pilots B, IRS size M, BS antennas Nt (pp. 11-12).
baselines: Classical: LS, SMJCE (CS-based). Learned: RS-OMP, DD-FS, SRDnCNN, DA-RLAMP, SFCNN (p. 9).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR, pilots B, IRS size and BS antennas; MSE of LS versus MBA; pilot overhead reduction up to 87%; estimation time (pp. 9-12).
complexity: Order O(2.5x10^5 Nt M K) compared with other methods; measured estimation time 41.77 ms at B=48 (Table IV, p. 12).
q1_support: p. 9: "We adopt the 3GPP TR 38.901 Release 17 CDL model to simulate a mmWave channel in a UMi scenario"
q2_support: p. 11: "are trained using channel data generated under the UMi scenario and then tested on the UMa scenario without any adaptation"
q3_support: p. 9: "We compare the MBA against several existing estimation techniques, including LS, SMJCE [14], RS-OMP [26], DDFS [27], SRDnNet [28], DA-RLAMP [29], and SFCNN [35]"; p. 10: "we compare the NMSE across different SNR levels"
q4_support: p. 12: "CMBA ≈ O(2.5 × 105 Nt M K)"; p. 12: "measured the average estimation time over 10,000 test samples across all subcarriers"
q5_support: p. 9: "80,000 channel samples were synthesized, with 50,000 for training, 20,000 for validation, and 10,000 for testing"; the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public dataset.
notes: PDF is the arXiv version (2605.15032v1) of the TCOMM paper; p. 1 gives DOI 10.1109/TCOMM.2025.3618696, so it is the right paper. q1 is 1 because p. 9 says the channel follows the 3GPP TR 38.901 Rel-17 CDL model, but the channel is built from eqs. (2)-(7) with 4 and 10 paths and delay and angular spreads from Table 7.5-6, so the reviewer may confirm it is not a custom simulator. q2 rests on the UMi-to-UMa test of p. 11 only, since the sweeps of Nt, M and B do not say whether the model was retrained. SMJCE is classed as non-learned because p. 11 lists it among the CS-based approaches, and LS is non-learned.
